# Ironwood Industrial — Portfolio Company (Industrials), IN EXIT

- **What it is:** a specialty industrial manufacturer; SCP's oldest current holding (invested
  2018). ~**$35M EBITDA**.
- **Status:** **in exit process.** Sell-side auction running with banker
  [Jonathan Pierce](../people/jonathan-pierce.md); expected exit **MOIC ~2.8x**, gross IRR ~22%.
- **CEO:** founder [Michael Devlin](../people/michael-devlin.md) — bootstrapped it for 18 years
  before SCP invested.

## Sensitivity — critical
- **Do not blindside Michael Devlin on the exit.** He must hear every buyer conversation from SCP
  before anyone else — he was previously blindsided by a banker and reacted badly. Buyer headcount
  plans are a hot button given his attachment to the plant workforce.

## Open items
- Ironwood CIM sign-off owed to [Jonathan Pierce](../people/jonathan-pierce.md) — see
  [commitments](../commitments.md).
- Manage Devlin through first-round bids.
